caribbean.headline: St. Lucia Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is experiencing 10 kt winds and 4.5 ft waves with 88% rain probability. Antigua reports 15 kt winds.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Faces Moderate Winds, Small Swell Today
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing sustained winds up to 25 kt, waves reaching 6.0 ft, with a dominant NNE swell period of 7 s and less than 10% rain probability. Venice will see calmer conditions, with winds peaking at 16 kt and minimal rainfall.
